subject.title: fix(nextcloud-talk): preserve current-room aliases across plugin upgrades

question: Should OpenClaw permanently guarantee that an authorized delegated exact-current action may provide an external channel plugin with the canonical current target alongside the model’s equivalent requested alias?
rationale: This is a compatibility and authorization-boundary choice affecting independently released plugins, not a mechanical defect that review automation can safely settle.

options.title: Approve the narrow shared contract
options.body: Keep this implementation, with the host-exact-current and external-plugin guards as the permanent compatibility boundary.

options.title: Make alias support plugin-owned
options.body: Keep core target interpretation unchanged and update the Nextcloud Talk plugin to recognize the supported alias across its own releases.

options.title: Define an explicit plugin API first
options.body: Pause this PR until maintainers choose and document a stable canonical-target capability for external channel plugins.

recommendation.title: Approve the narrow shared contract
recommendation.body: Keep this implementation, with the host-exact-current and external-plugin guards as the permanent compatibility boundary.

likelyOwner.reason: A core owner should decide the long-term shared plugin and authorization contract.
